patch_list: Bypasses foodpanda's DeliveryHero MAS integrity block — forces the master security gate (`w9u.a`) to report the device/app as trusted AND short-circuits the enforcement orchestrator that launches the block screen, so re-signed / sideloaded…

Rewrites foodpanda's baked-in Bento color constants to dark equivalents so the app renders a real dark theme. The app ships no dark palette — R8 merged its light and dark token sets into one identical set of dex constants — so theme, force…

Removes foodpanda's adtech banner ads (all placements: order-tracking, home, discovery, reels) and the forced PandaMart "CrossSell" popup, and suppresses the forced in-app review prompt (DeliveryHero InAppRatingActivity).

Unlocks foodpanda pandapro — forces every `isSubscribed()` check (status instanceof UserSubscriptionStatus.Subscribed) to report subscribed and forces Subscribed.hasBenefits() true, so the app's pro state, UI and entitlement gates unlock.…
